epics.summary: EPIC-005: Dashboard — Category Views & Actions Center

mapping.user_story: As a developer I want the shared infrastructure components configured and ready So that all subsequent stories can build on a solid foundation.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the project structure (Sprint 0 complete), When this story is implemented, Then the following are configured and tested: PromptApiClient bean (WebClient, 40s timeout for wizard, 60s for processor) in both services, PromptTemplateRegistrar for registering prompt templates on startup, EmailService interface + SendGrid implementation skeleton, KafkaConfig with all 8 topic definitions, RedisConfig for wizard rate limiting, Resilience4j CircuitBreaker configuration per LLM provider, SecurityConfig with Auth0 integration and CORS whitelist, Flyway baseline configuration, geo-flink-jobs Maven module created with Flink 1.20 dependencies

gwt.given: the project structure (Sprint 0 complete)
gwt.then: the following are configured and tested: PromptApiClient bean (WebClient, 40s timeout for wizard, 60s for processor) in both services, PromptTemplateRegistrar for registering prompt templates on startup, EmailService interface + SendGrid implementation skeleton, KafkaConfig with all 8 topic definitions, RedisConfig for wizard rate limiting, Resilience4j CircuitBreaker configuration per LLM provider, SecurityConfig with Auth0 integration and CORS whitelist, Flyway baseline configuration, geo-flink-jobs Maven module created with Flink 1.20 dependencies

mapping.user_story: As an Editor or Reader I want to log in via Auth0 SSO and have my organization automatically resolved So that I can securely access only my organization's data.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a user with valid Auth0 credentials, When they authenticate via Auth0, Then the system extracts organisationId from the JWT token and sets TenantContext, all subsequent API requests are scoped to that organization, Auth0 tokens are validated on every API request

gwt.given: a user with valid Auth0 credentials
gwt.then: the system extracts organisationId from the JWT token and sets TenantContext, all subsequent API requests are scoped to that organization, Auth0 tokens are validated on every API request

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an unauthenticated user accessing a protected endpoint, When the request has no valid token, Then the system returns 401 Unauthorized

gwt.given: an unauthenticated user accessing a protected endpoint
gwt.when: the request has no valid token
gwt.then: the system returns 401 Unauthorized

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated Reader, When they attempt to access Editor-only actions (create/edit/delete report), Then the system returns 403 Forbidden

gwt.given: an authenticated Reader
gwt.when: they attempt to access Editor-only actions (create/edit/delete report)
gwt.then: the system returns 403 Forbidden

mapping.user_story: As a user I want the system to check if the Mesure module is activated for my organization So that I'm redirected to the sales page if not activated, or shown the module if activated.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated user whose organization does NOT have the Mesure module activated, When they navigate to the Mesure module, Then the system redirects them to the sales/upgrade page

gwt.given: an authenticated user whose organization does NOT have the Mesure module activated
gwt.when: they navigate to the Mesure module
gwt.then: the system redirects them to the sales/upgrade page

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated user whose organization HAS the module activated but no reports exist, When they navigate to the Mesure module, Then the system displays an empty state with illustration and "Create Report" CTA button

gwt.given: an authenticated user whose organization HAS the module activated but no reports exist
gwt.when: they navigate to the Mesure module
gwt.then: the system displays an empty state with illustration and "Create Report" CTA button

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated user whose organization HAS the module activated and reports exist, When they navigate to the Mesure module, Then the system displays the report list (Story 1.3)

gwt.given: an authenticated user whose organization HAS the module activated and reports exist
gwt.when: they navigate to the Mesure module
gwt.then: the system displays the report list (Story 1.3)

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want to view a list of all reports for my organization with status and date So that I can see what's been configured and its current state.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated Editor with existing reports, When they view the report list, Then the system displays report name, status badge (PENDING/CONFIGURED), creation date, number of markets, and number of categories, results are sorted by most recent first, the list supports sorting and filtering, the list is paginated (limit/offset), the list loads within 1 second

gwt.given: an authenticated Editor with existing reports
gwt.then: the system displays report name, status badge (PENDING/CONFIGURED), creation date, number of markets, and number of categories, results are sorted by most recent first, the list supports sorting and filtering, the list is paginated (limit/offset), the list loads within 1 second

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated Reader, When they view the report list, Then they see the same list in read-only mode (no create/edit/delete actions)

gwt.given: an authenticated Reader
gwt.then: they see the same list in read-only mode (no create/edit/delete actions)

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an authenticated user from organization A, When they view the report list, Then they only see reports belonging to organization A (zero cross-tenant data)

gwt.given: an authenticated user from organization A
gwt.then: they only see reports belonging to organization A (zero cross-tenant data)

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want a 4-step wizard layout with navigation controls So that I can progress through report configuration in a structured flow.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Editor creating a new report, When the wizard loads, Then a 4-step stepper is displayed (Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts, Review), steps are navigable via Next/Back buttons, a sticky header shows current step title + progress bar, a sticky footer shows the CTA button

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Editor navigating back with unsaved changes, When isPristine is false, Then a "Discard Changes" modal is shown (462x222px)

gwt.given: an Editor navigating back with unsaved changes
gwt.then: a "Discard Changes" modal is shown (462x222px)

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want to search and select a brand with auto-complete suggestions So that I can identify my brand with its logo and domain.

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want AI to detect relevant categories for my brand across my selected countries So that I don't have to manually research what categories apply.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the Editor on the categories result page, When they click "+ Add Category", Then they can enter a custom category name which is auto-translated for all markets, the custom category shows a "CUSTOM" badge

gwt.then: a confirmation modal ("Removal") is shown, if only 1 category remains, the delete icon is hidden (Last One Rule)

acceptance_criteria.text: Given category discovery returns 0 results, When the empty state is displayed, Then it shows an illustration + "Add Custom Category" CTA

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the Editor with at least 1 category, When they click "Review Prompts", Then the system proceeds to Step 3

acceptance_criteria.text: Edit Category modal (640x592px) with "Auto-translate" button

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want to review and customize the auto-generated questions for each category and market So that the analysis asks exactly what matters to my brand.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the Editor hovers over a question, When hover actions appear (pencil + trash icons), Then they can edit inline (Enter to save, Escape to cancel) or delete (with undo toast 5s)

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want to review a summary of my configuration and select AI engines before submitting So that I can verify everything is correct before the analysis runs.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Editor on Step 4, When the review page loads, Then it displays "Ready to analyze {Brand}" with subtitle "Configure your multi-country brand analysis", 3 summary cards: Countries count, Categories count, Total Questions count, a section "What AI engines are you considering?" with LLM toggle cards

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Editor disabling ALL LLMs, When all toggles are OFF, Then the system auto-reactivates all LLMs (Smart-Select: never 0 active)

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an Editor clicking "Review & Launch", When the configuration is submitted, Then the system performs double quota validation (frontend + backend re-check), saves atomically: report + markets + categories + questions + LLM config, inserts report_job_queue entry with status PENDING, increments brand_markets_used in quota, returns 201 Created

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a first-time configuration (no prior report), When saved successfully, Then the user is redirected to the report page (analysis starts automatically in V2)

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a subsequent edit of an existing report, When saved successfully, Then changes are saved immediately; results produced at next scheduled weekly execution

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want the system to validate quotas at each step and show clear warnings So that I don't exceed my organization's limits.

gwt.given: an Editor at any wizard step
gwt.when: a quota limit is reached (markets, categories, questions per type, LLMs)

gwt.given: the brand_markets quota is about to be exceeded
gwt.when: the Editor tries to add more markets than allowed
gwt.then: the system shows "You have reached the maximum number of markets you can add. Please contact our sales team if you wish to add more."

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the Editor submits the configuration, When backend validates quotas, Then it checks: brand_markets_used + new_markets <= max_brand_markets, categories <= max_categories, questions per type <= max_q_{type}, enabled LLMs <= max_llms, returns 400 for structural limits, 403 for brand_market quota exceeded

gwt.given: the Editor submits the configuration
gwt.then: it checks: brand_markets_used + new_markets <= max_brand_markets, categories <= max_categories, questions per type <= max_q_{type}, enabled LLMs <= max_llms, returns 400 for structural limits, 403 for brand_market quota exceeded

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want my report to start analyzing automatically after first-time configuration So that I get results without manual intervention.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a report just submitted (status PENDING), When Flink polls every 90s with SKIP LOCKED, Then questions are dispatched to Kafka topics per enabled LLM

gwt.given: a report just submitted (status PENDING)
gwt.when: Flink polls every 90s with SKIP LOCKED
gwt.then: questions are dispatched to Kafka topics per enabled LLM

acceptance_criteria.text: Given questions dispatched, When LLM dispatchers send to Prompt API at calibrated rates (OpenAI ~6ms, Claude ~15ms, Gemini ~40ms, Grok ~100ms, Perplexity ~120ms), Then responses are persisted to PostgreSQL first, then published to kafka-responses

gwt.given: questions dispatched
gwt.when: LLM dispatchers send to Prompt API at calibrated rates (OpenAI ~6ms, Claude ~15ms, Gemini ~40ms, Grok ~100ms, Perplexity ~120ms)
gwt.then: responses are persisted to PostgreSQL first, then published to kafka-responses

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an LLM call fails after 3 retries, Then response saved with status=FAILED, published to Kafka with status=FAILED, pipeline continues (never blocked)

gwt.given: an LLM call fails after 3 retries
gwt.then: response saved with status=FAILED, published to Kafka with status=FAILED, pipeline continues (never blocked)

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a Circuit Breaker opens for one LLM (>5% errors), Then only that dispatcher pauses 30s, others continue

gwt.given: a Circuit Breaker opens for one LLM (>5% errors)
gwt.then: only that dispatcher pauses 30s, others continue

acceptance_criteria.text: Given Flink counting responses via keyBy(reportId) + RocksDB, When every ~10 responses, Then progress event published to kafka-report-status

gwt.then: progress event published to kafka-report-status

acceptance_criteria.text: Given analysis completes, Then Editor receives {type: "complete", status: "COMPLETED"/"COMPLETED_PARTIAL"/"FAILED"}

gwt.then: Editor receives {type: "complete", status: "COMPLETED"/"COMPLETED_PARTIAL"/"FAILED"}

acceptance_criteria.text: Given SSE connection drops, When client reconnects, Then current state received immediately, heartbeat every 30s, max 5 connections/key, TTL 30min

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want the system to identify my top competitors from AI visibility results So that competitive analysis uses real market data instead of placeholders.

acceptance_criteria.text: Brand matching via Gemini AI (2-step: text similarity + AI grouping → normalized_name)
Extract top 5 competitors per market × category (by mention count desc, avg position asc, penalty rank 11 for absent)
Replace [Competitor 1-5] placeholders in memory (original templates preserved), dispatch Phase 2 competitive questions to Kafka
Emit progress events 40→50% via geo-report-status
Edge cases — zero visibility questions (skip), target brand absent, fewer than 5 competitors, Gemini failure (fallback to text similarity)

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want AI-generated reputation insights (concepts, sentiment) per category and market So that I understand how AI engines perceive my brand.

acceptance_criteria.text: Edge cases — zero perception responses (skip), Gemini failure (1 retry then skip scope), idempotent on duplicate trigger

mapping.user_story: As an Editor I want competitive analysis completed and all citation sources classified So that I can see my brand vs competitors and know which publications to target.

acceptance_criteria.text: Extract sources from ALL responses (visibility + perception + competitive), create response_sources rows
3-level source classification (regex → shared cache → Gemini) with 11 categories
11 source categories with priority rules (Brand → Owned, Competitor → Competitor Media)
Report finalization — Processor publishes PIPELINE_COMPLETE, ReportStatusService evaluates COMPLETED/COMPLETED_PARTIAL/FAILED
Progress events 50→100% (Phase 2 counting + enrichment + classification + finalization)
